sloka: भूत्वा शकुनयः सर्वे प्रविष्टासः च रिपोर् बलम् ।विधानम् विहितम् यच् च तद् द्Rष्ट्वा समुपस्थिताः ॥६-३७-८॥।।
transliteration: bhūtvā śakunayaḥ sarve praviṣṭāsaḥ ca ripor balam ।vidhānam vihitam yac ca tad dRṣṭvā samupasthitāḥ ॥6-37-8॥।।

translations.english: All of them assumed the form of birds and went deep into Lanka, saw the enemy strength and arrangements made by the enemy and turned up.
